exhibits.title: Spot Price
exhibits.statement: Chainlink (LINK) traded at $9.1800 as of 2026-11-17 15:37:55 UTC, -0.43% over one hour and +1.67% over twenty-four hours.

exhibits.title: 24-Hour Trading Range
exhibits.statement: Over twenty-four hours the price ranged from $9.0700 to $9.3500; spot sits at 39% of that range.

exhibits.title: Seven-Day Trend
exhibits.statement: Price is -10.44% over seven days. The 24-hour average ($9.1727) is above the 72-hour average ($9.1408). Spot is 12.64% below the seven-day high of $10.5087 and 5.75% above the seven-day low of $8.6809.

exhibits.title: Volatility & Momentum
exhibits.statement: Realized volatility computed from hourly closes is 4.17% per day. The 14-hour relative strength index reads 56.0, conventionally neutral.

exhibits.title: Liquidity
exhibits.statement: Twenty-four-hour trading volume was $192.12 million, equal to 2.73% of the $7.04 billion market capitalization.

exhibits.title: Market Sentiment
exhibits.statement: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index reads 12 ("Extreme Fear"), versus 32 7 days earlier.

exhibits.title: Chainlink Price Feed
exhibits.statement: The Chainlink LINK/USD Data Feed on Ethereum mainnet last reported $9.2583, 17 minutes before the spot quote and +0.85% against the spot price in Exhibit A. Practice positions are entered and settled at this mark.

arguments.text:
May it please the Court.  

1. The spot price sits near the lower end of its 24‑hour range, at 39% of that band, indicating immediate upside potential as buyers seek value within a bounded market [Ex. B].  

2. Despite a seven‑day decline, the 24‑hour average ($9.1727) already exceeds the 72‑hour average ($9.1408), showing short‑term momentum reversal while volatility remains modest at 4.17% per day, limiting downside risk [Ex. C, D].  

3. Market sentiment is in the “Extreme Fear” zone (12), a classic contrarian signal that historically precedes price rebounds, and the authoritative Chainlink price feed trades at $9.2583, a 0.85% premium to spot, confirming a higher fair value for a long practice position [Ex. F, G].  

The Bull rests.

May it please the Court.  

1. The spot price of LINK is anchored near the lower‑third of its 24‑hour range (39% of the range) and sits $0.17 below the Chainlink on‑chain data feed, indicating immediate downside pressure and a mispricing that a short practice can capture [Ex. A, B, G].  

2. Although realized volatility is modest (4.17% per day), the seven‑day trend is sharply negative at –10.44%, and the 24‑hour average already exceeds the 72‑hour average, showing a decelerating rebound that is unlikely to reverse without external catalyst [Ex. C, D].  

3. Market sentiment is at an extreme fear level (12), historically a contrarian signal of further selling pressure, while liquidity remains ample to support short entry without market impact [Ex. E, F].  

For these reasons the Bear respectfully asks the Court to open a short practice position in LINK/USD. The Bear rests.

Your Honor, the Bear’s first claim that LINK is “anchored near the lower‑third of its 24‑hour range” ignores that the spot sits at 39 % of the range, which is still well within the band and not a decisive breach; the price remains above the seven‑day low by 5.75 % and the 24‑hour average exceeds the 72‑hour average, signaling short‑term strength despite a recent dip [Ex. B, C].  

Second, the Bear touts “extreme fear” as a contrarian sell signal, yet the RSI is 56—neutral, and realized volatility is modest at 4.17 % per day, indicating no acute momentum to drive further declines [Ex. D, F].  

Nothing further.

Your Honor, the Bull’s first point collapses under Exhibit B: the price sits at the low‑end of a narrow $0.28 band, but that band is itself compressed; a 39% position offers no meaningful upside because any bounce will be capped by the $9.35 ceiling, limiting profit potential. Moreover, Exhibit F’s Fear‑Greed Index at 12 does not guarantee a reversal; extreme fear often signals capitulation and can precede further declines, especially when paired with the seven‑day downtrend of –10.44% in Exhibit C, indicating persistent bearish pressure. Thus the Bull’s contrarian case is unsubstantiated. Nothing further.

ruling.holding: The Court finds that the evidence supports a short practice position in LINK/USD.

findings.finding: Spot price is $9.1800, down 0.43% hourly and 1.67% daily, showing immediate weakness
Seven‑day trend is –10.44% and price remains 12.64% below the seven‑day high
Crypto Fear & Greed Index at 12 indicates extreme fear, historically associated with continued selling pressure
RSI at 56 is neutral and volatility modest at 4.17% per day, limiting upside momentum
On‑chain price feed trades at $9.2583, a 0.85% premium to spot, suggesting spot is undervalued and vulnerable to downside

ruling.opinion: The exhibits show LINK priced near the low end of its narrow 24‑hour range and descending sharply over seven days [Ex. A, C]. Neutral RSI and modest volatility provide little bullish catalyst [Ex. D], while extreme fear signals further downside risk [Ex. F]. The on‑chain feed’s premium to spot underscores a mispricing that can be exploited by a short practice position [Ex. G]. Accordingly, the balance of evidence favors a short position.
ruling.dissent: The Bull argues that the 24‑hour average surpasses the 72‑hour average and that extreme fear is a contrarian rebound signal, but these points are outweighed by the broader downtrend and lack of bullish momentum.
